subject: 280 Mystic Avenue Comprehensive Permit
overview: The board resumed consideration of a Chapter 40B comprehensive permit application for a proposed 378-unit residential development at 280 Mystic Avenue. The board voted to authorize peer review consultants and working sessions, and continued the hearing to May 30, 2024, for a scheduling and status update.

items.title: 280 Mystic Avenue Comprehensive Permit (Case 40B-2024-01)
items.summary: Combined Properties presented an eight-story, 378-unit residential development proposal with 25 percent affordable housing, stormwater improvements, and an updated traffic study plan.

items.title: Peer Review and Working Sessions Authorization
items.summary: The board approved motions to authorize the city to retain peer review consultants for architecture, civil engineering, and traffic, and to permit city staff and the applicant to hold direct working sessions.

items.title: Continuance to May 30, 2024
items.summary: The board voted to continue the hearing to May 30, 2024, at 6:30 p.m. for a status and scheduling update.
